## 17000 - 17131

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="17000">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />17000 EXTVOL - External volume</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="17000">

This is a header exception; it is never generated in FLOWCAL. These exceptions primarily address text file imports and meter status.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="17001">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />17001 EXTVOL - Meter was automatically created by external volume import</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="17001">

This exception is generated when importing a Meter Text File into a FLOWCAL database, and a Meter within the Text File does not exist on the FLOWCAL database.  For the auto-creation to occur, the Service Configuration Option in the Text File Import group box must be set to Auto Create for Meters. This exception is to let the user know that the meter was automatically created.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="17002">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />17002 EXTVOL - Replaced previous data</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="17002">

This exception is generated when importing a Meter Text File into a FLOWCAL database, and Revision 0 exists for the meter. This newly imported data will replace the Revision 0 data that was originally there.  

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="17003">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />17003 EXTVOL - Inactive meter</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="17003">

This exception is generated when data is imported or manually entered into a meter where the status of the meter is Inactive. This is set in Meter Characteristics in the Operations tab and can be manually changed to Active (if desired) to resolve the exception. Often this is falsely generated because the meter is set to Inactive on the CFX File (when it should not be). Users would need to get in contact with their Measurement Manager to update the Flow Computer settings so this status comes in properly.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="17004">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />17004 EXTVOL - Disconnected meter</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="17004">

This exception is generated when data is imported or manually entered into a meter where the status of the meter is Disconnected. This is set in Meter Characteristics in the Operations tab and can be manually changed to Active (if desired) to resolve the exception. Often this is falsely generated because the meter is set to Disconnected on the CFX File (when it should not be). Users would need to get in contact with their Measurement Manager to update the Flow Computer settings so this status comes in properly.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="17005">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />17005 EXTVOL - Record rejected due to import rule</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="17005">

This exception is generated when a user has set up an Import Rule in the Import Rule Editor. In the Import Rule Editor, user may create rules to reject the import of specific periodic records. Users may then apply these rules to a specific meter via the Meter Editor (Imports tab; Conditional Import Rules). If the Import rule prevents any records from being successfully imported, then the exception will be generated to let the user know their record was attempted to be imported, but was prevented by the import rule set on the meter. 

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="17006">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />17006 EXTVOL - Meter has no flow computer assigned for product mapping/cross reference</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="17006">

This exception is generated when a file is imported into a Meter, and has the Flow Computer Mapping set to Yes in the Meter Editor, Imports Tab. However, there is not a Flow Computer mapping setup for the meter in the Flow Computer Editor.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="17007">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />17007 EXTVOL - Assigned flow computer ID is different than ID in CFX file</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="17007">

This exception is generated when the Computer ID on the CFX file that was generated is different than the Computer ID that was input into the Flow Computer Editor. For this exception to have been generated, a user would have to create a Flow Computer via the Flow Computer Editor and map products to the index associated with the Flow Computer. Then the user would have to assign the Flow Computer to a Meter via the Meter Editor, Imports tab. Once that is done, the Computer ID that is generated on the CFX file must then not match the Number on the Flow Computer in the Flow Computer Editor.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="17008">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />17008 EXTVOL - CFX product number/code must be between 1 and 32</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="17008">

This exception is generated when the Product Number/Code on the CFX file that was generated is not between 1 to 32. For this exception to have been generated, a user would have to create a Flow Computer via the Flow Computer Editor and map products to the index associated with the Flow Computer. Then the user would have to assign the Flow Computer to a Meter via the Meter Editor, Imports tab.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="17009">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />17009 EXTVOL - CFX product number/code is not mapped to flow computer</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="17009">

This exception is generated when the Flow Computer ID matches the Flow Computer in FLOWCAL but the product mapping set in the Flow Computer editor does NOT match. To resolve this exception, it would be ideal to add the mapping to the Flow Computer in the Flow Computer Editor so future imports with that product will come in easily.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="17010">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />17010 EXTVOL - Nonexistent meter</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="17010">

This exception is generated when data is imported or manually entered into a meter where the status of the meter is Nonexistent. This is set in Meter Characteristics in the Operations tab and can be manually changed to Active (if desired) to resolve the exception. Often this is falsely generated because the meter is set to Nonexistent on the CFX File (when it should not be). Users would need to get in contact with their Measurement Manager to update the Flow Computer settings so this status comes in properly.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="17011">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />17011 EXTVOL - Batch split due to product change</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="17011">

This exception occurs when a product is imported into a batch time frame that contained another product. For example, if a meter had a Product of Propane for all of August 2016 and a product of Ethane was imported on to that meter, because FLOWCAL cannot have two products for one batch, a batch split will occur. This exception lets the user know that this has occurred.

</div>

#### 17012 EXTVOL - BI - Record not imported; batch is finalized (deprecated)

#### 17013 EXTVOL - Characteristic change not propagated; periodic is finalized (deprecated)

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="17100">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />17100 GQTEXT - GQ source text file</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="17100">

GQ source text file (GQTEXT) validations that is run when GQ data is imported through a text file. The limits for GQTEXT exceptions are defined in Variance tab of the Source Quality Validations form. GQTEXT validations consist of a check on GPM data for gas analysis, and other checks for duplicate records and alkenes.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="17101">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />17101 GQTEXT - GQ source was automatically created by text file import</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="17101">

This exception is created for a Gas Quality Source or a Liquid Quality Source when a GQ Source or a LQ Source is auto-created by a source analysis text file being imported.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="17102">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />17102 GQTEXT - Percent deviation too high (ethane (C2) GPM)</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="17102">

This exception is generated upon import of a source analysis record that has the Ethane C2 GPM value that varies from the value calculated by FLOWCAL by more than the Percent limit set in the Variance validations for the quality source. For example, the imported sample has Ethane C2 GPM value of 3.8624. Ethane C2 GPM calculated by FLOWCAL based on the sample values is 3.8597. The limit defined in Variance validation is 0.05 Percent. Since the imported value differs from the calculated value by abs(3.8624 / 3.8597 – 1) \* 100 = 0.0699%, which is greater than 0.05%, this exception is generated.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="17103">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />17103 GQTEXT - Percent deviation too high (propane (C3) GPM)</a>

The limit defined in Variance validation is 0.05 Percent. Since the imported value differs from the calculated value by abs(1.6994 / 1.6985 - 1) \* 100 = 0.0530%, which is greater than 0.05%, this exception is generated.

</div>

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />17115 GQTEXT - Amount deviation too high (ethane (C2) GPM)</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="17115">

This exception is generated upon import of a source  analysis record that has the Ethane C2 GPM value that varies from the value calculated by FLOWCAL by more than the Delta limit set in the Variance validations for the quality source. For example, the imported sample has Ethane C2 GPM value of 3.8674. Ethane C2 GPM calculated by FLOWCAL based on the sample values is 3.8597. The limit defined in Variance validation is 0.005. Since the imported value differs from the calculated value by abs(3.8674 - 3.8597) = 0.0077, which is greater than 0.005, this exception is generated.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="17126">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />17126 GQTEXT – Duplicate GQ source analysis record imported; one second added and record set to “Inhibited”</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="17126">

This exception is generated on a source analysis record for a GQ source when the imported source analysis record is a duplicate of an existing record for the GQ. For this validation to be enabled, in the Effective Date Determination groupbox on the Main tab of the GQ Source Editor, the Override Effective Date on Import option needs to be checked and Date Rule needs to be specified. If these options are not specified, duplicate source analysis records will not be imported.

Upon import of source analysis records that would generate this exception, 1 second is added to the effective date of the record. Therefore, if a record at 1/1/2017 12:00:00 is imported three times, the effective date of the record will be 1/1/2017 12:00:02 in the end. Upon such import, the import record will also be inhibited.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" />

</div>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="17130">

This exception is generated when the value of the sediment water percent imported with flow data is less than zero. To resolve, the user would need to edit the sediment water percent to a valid value between 0 and 5 percent.

</div>
